description: This file defines the AOS_QuotesViewDetail class, which extends a parent ViewDetail class and handles displaying detailed views of quote records in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for populating quote template options and rendering HTML templates for popups.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class that manages the display of detailed quote information within SuiteCRM, including populating templates and rendering popup HTML.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that invokes the parent class constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to populate quote templates and show the popup HTML before calling the parent display method.

methods.name: populateQuoteTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves active quote templates from the database and populates the application list strings with template IDs and names.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the appropriate Smarty template for the quote templates popup, based on the availability of templates.
